semantics: Rules are applied in order; the first matching glob wins. Exact path rules therefore precede broad directory rules.

dispositions.canonical-source: Contains durable material that must be extracted into the canonical synthesis before this source becomes archival.
dispositions.retained-evidence: Supports a surviving claim or control and remains versioned pending artifact migration.
dispositions.retained-toolbox: Reusable implementation or verifier to keep and organize.
dispositions.retained-control: Known-system reproduction or bounded control, not a discovery result.
dispositions.archive-provenance: Historical audit record; preserve but remove from active navigation.
dispositions.archive-history: Frozen derivation, runner or case-study source; preserve until references are migrated.
dispositions.externalize-after-manifest: Large evidence payload; move only after checksums and references are independently verified.
dispositions.relocate-fixture: Immutable tracked fixture currently mixed with active data.
dispositions.generated-cache: Reproducible ignored workspace state, not evidence.
dispositions.source-cache: Fetched third-party source cache governed by a tracked catalog.
dispositions.split-required: Useful file combines multiple responsibilities and needs structural decomposition.
dispositions.rewrite-entrypoint: Active navigation document is stale or overgrown and must be replaced by a concise generated/synthesized view.
dispositions.remove-generated: Generated packaging/build metadata that should be regenerated rather than curated.
dispositions.review-required: No safe automatic disposition; human classification required before migration.
